{{Quote|In a move that stunned political observers, the Dentaal Independence Party, with full public support, ousted the Imperial administration of Governor Taliff and took direct control of the Dentaalian government it had vacated only nine months earlier. The commanders of the Dentaalian Navy and Army, nominally under Imperial control, have declared their loyalty to the new government, and are moving to isolate and disarm Imperial garrisons.|[[Imperial HoloVision]]|<ref name="AJ5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
The '''Dentaalian Army''' was a military force on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]]. Although nominally allied with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the leaders of the army supported [[Hancc Rellow]] and the [[Dentaal Independence Party]] when they declared independence and expelled [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Taliff]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="AJ5" />
